magipass.imageAlt: Magipass logo: three white sparkles on a blue background
magipass.problem: Exclusive offers from partner businesses needed one app where customers buy passes and redeem offers, and where businesses and administrators manage them.
magipass.role: I designed the architecture and built both the mobile app and the backend, implemented as a RESTful API.
features: Sign-in through external identity providers or email and password
Three user roles — customers, registered business owners and administrators — each with its own workflows and interfaces
outcomes: Published on the App Store and Google Play.

qrypt.imageAlt: QRypt logo: a QR Code with a shield in the middle
qrypt.problem: QR Codes are being abused for quishing — phishing that hides a malicious link or a fraudulent payment behind a code placed in a public spot.
features: Mandatory authentication to create a QR Code
Encryption of every generated code to protect the integrity and validity of its content
Community reporting that automatically disables a code once it reaches a set number of reports

entropyle.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Entropyle word game
entropyle.problem: Word games reward a fixed strategy once you know the loop. Entropyle breaks that by changing the rules every round.
features: Hidden-word guessing with the classic color feedback
A random modifier every round — it might invert the letters, reveal a clue or take away a guess
Strategy that has to adapt on the fly as the rules shift
outcomes: Live on the web, with the source code on GitHub.

deepquiz.problem: Static quizzes can't adapt to what a learner already knows. DeepQuiz generates questions on demand and adjusts to the user's level.
features: Questions and answers generated dynamically with Google's Gemini API
A learning experience that adapts to the user's knowledge level
An interactive interface for many areas of interest
outcomes: Live on the web, with the source code on GitHub.
